reviews.review_description: Wolf was very flexible and managed to accommodate 11 panels on a small roof.  He spent time explaining the system and the paperwork was all really efficiently handled and sent promptly so I was able to apply for the Solar Rebate very easily plus provide all the relevant documentation with the minimum of fuss.  I felt from the start that Wolf was honest and straightforward with all the challenges and delivered me a system that was suitable for my needs

i chose Wolf Electrical (Wolfgang Stueckle) on the recommendation of a friend. I am glad I did. He impressed me from our initial meeting: he made no outlandish claims, and he did not pressure me into buying a system. He checked my electricity bills checked the roof and property and recommended a system, but he did stress the fact that he dealt only in quality components.After I gave him the contract I was impressed by his attention to detail, his work ethic and, the quality of his work. His customer service is exemplary. I have no hesitation in recommending Wolfgang.

Wolf from Wolf Electrical was fast with his quote (I got three quotes). He was not pushy, and I felt he suggested the best system for my budget and needs.He kept in contact, assisted with my rebate application needs and did a good job on the installation without trying to rush it. He also cleaned up afterwards!I am very happy with the outcome.
